caption: The drawing depicts a young girl with long, curly, blonde hair that reaches her shoulders. She is wearing a dress with a plaid pattern made up of red squares bordered with dark green, yellow, and blue lines. The dress features a high lace collar, brown cuffs, and a brown band around the hem. Her hands are gloved in light gray or white gloves. She is also wearing white stockings with a subtle grid-like pattern and dark brown shoes with a strap across the instep. The background is plain and unadorned, with some light marks or smudges visible on the surface. There is a small signature or inscription in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Doll - "Florence"
